_note: Weather of a Weltbauer room (src/world_kit/room_weather.gd): a room file names one `weather` (falling: what comes down) and any `weather_extra` (laid over it). The game draws it over the picture while the hero is in that room and fades it in and out over `fade` s. falls: count = particles on a 1920 wide screen, speed = [min, max] px per second down, drift = px per second sideways, size = [min, max] px, alpha, streak = length of a streak in px (0 = round flake), haze = a white wash at most this strong, gust = seconds of one gust of the haze. extras: fog = drifting banks (count, size, alpha, speed), diamond = twinkling sparkles (count, alpha), aurora = curtains at the top (bands, height share of the screen, alpha, colours), rime = frost creeping in from the edges (width share, alpha), night = a cold dark over all (alpha). labels: what the Weltbauer shows.
